faq: Which file types can you import?
Spreadsheets such as CSV and Excel files, and exports from other CRMs or email tools. If your data sits somewhere unusual, send a sample and we tell you before we start whether it can be moved.
Will you delete my old data?
No. We never delete the source file, and we do not remove records without a clear rule. Doubtful duplicates are listed for you to decide, and we keep a copy of the original so you can compare.
Is it safe to import customer lists?

Only import people you may lawfully contact. We do not buy, scrape or add third party lists. We work in your CRM, keep files private, and you should delete the shared copies once you approve the import.
What if my data is very messy?
That is common. We check a sample first and tell you if the file needs extra time. Heavy cleanup beyond the package limit can be added, and you see the cost before we continue.
desc:
CRM data import and cleanup moves your contacts from spreadsheets or an old tool into your CRM as tidy, deduplicated records. Ecom Swift LLC maps every column to the right field, merges obvious duplicates and links people to their companies.

## What is CRM data import and cleanup?

CRM data import and cleanup is the work of turning scattered contact lists into reliable records inside a customer relationship management system. The source might be a spreadsheet, a CSV export, a mailing list or the database of a tool you are leaving. The cleanup part removes duplicates, fixes formatting and decides which details belong in which field.

An import is a one-way door. Once thousands of rows are inside the CRM, every mistake is copied into every report, email and reminder that follows. That is why the preparation matters more than the upload itself.

## Why messy data costs you more than it seems

A CRM is only as useful as the records inside it. When the same customer appears three times, three salespeople may contact them in one week. When a phone number is stored in a notes column, nobody can call from the record. When company names are spelled five different ways, you cannot see everyone you know at one business.

Bad data also damages trust in the tool. If a new user's first search returns blanks and duplicates, they go back to their own spreadsheet.

## How clean data improves your sales work

Clean records make everything downstream easier. Searches return one result per person. Email and call history gathers on a single contact. Segments and tags are accurate, so a campaign reaches the right people and nobody gets the same message twice.

Reports also become honest. Counts of leads, customers and companies reflect reality, so you can judge your pipeline without mentally subtracting the duplicates. Your team spends its time selling instead of hunting for the correct version of a record.

## What a good import includes

- A review of the source file before anything is loaded, so problems are found early.
- Column mapping that matches each spreadsheet column to a standard or custom CRM field.
- Format fixes for names, phone numbers, email addresses, countries and dates.
- Duplicate detection on email, phone and name, with obvious matches merged.
- A separate list of doubtful matches for you to approve instead of guessing.
- Contacts linked to the right company record where the data allows.
- Tags or lifecycle labels created from source columns such as lead source or customer type.
- A small test batch loaded first and checked before the full run.
- A short report covering what was imported, merged, skipped and why.

## How we run the project

We start by looking at your source files and your CRM fields. If a detail has no home yet, we suggest a new custom field rather than forcing it into notes. We then clean the file in a working copy, so your original export stays untouched.

Next we load a small test batch, open a few records together with you and confirm the fields look right. Only then do we run the full import. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ mainly in the volume of records, the number of source files and whether we also tidy records that already sit in your CRM.

When the import finishes, you receive the summary report. It lists the counts, the merges we made and the records we left out, so you can see exactly what changed.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep a copy of every original file before the import starts.
- Tell us which fields matter most to your team.
- Decide in advance what counts as a duplicate in your business, for example the same email or the same phone.
- Review the doubtful matches list promptly.
- Check a handful of imported records yourself after the test batch.

**Avoid:**
- Importing a file you have not looked at, hoping the CRM will sort it out.
- Merging records only by name, since two different people can share one.
- Mixing old contacts who never opted in with active customers in one list.
- Deleting the source file the moment the import ends.
- Running several imports from different people at the same time.

## Who this service is for

It suits a small business that has run on spreadsheets and is finally moving to a CRM. It also suits a team switching from one CRM to another that needs its history carried across without the clutter. And it suits an owner whose CRM already contains years of messy entries, who wants the existing records tidied alongside the new ones.

## What we need from you

Send us the spreadsheets or exports you want imported, plus a note on which columns matter most and any contacts that must be excluded. We also need to work inside your CRM, so please add us as a user or admin where your plan allows. We never need your password, and you stay in control of the account throughout.
